Add a declarative multi-stage pipeline model: `pipeline.py` describes a whole agent pipeline as validated data (the inputs the operator supplies, the stages in order with their steps, actors, produced artifacts, and mechanical gates, and the outputs the run delivers), with validators that make structurally inconsistent pipelines unconstructable. A stage executor iterates this object; the first pipeline built on it is the behaviors witness pipeline, which lands on a stacked branch.

Add `pipeline_svg.py`, a deterministic, dependency-free SVG renderer for that model, and `scripts/render_pipeline_svg.py`, which renders any pipeline named by a dotted `module:attribute` reference to an SVG file, so committed diagrams can be pinned to their models by drift tests and regenerated with one command.
